 Date of Decision : 28.01.2025
M/s Tikaya Ram Des Raj and sons ...Petitioners
 Versus
State of Punjab and others ...Respondents
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Tiwari

Present: Mr. Vipul Babuta, Advocate
 for the petitioners.

Mr. Pardeep Bajaj, Dag,
 Ag, Punjab.
1. Learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned State counsel are ad idem that

the order dated 16.05.2023 (Annexure P P-4),
4), which is impugned before this Court, by filing the instant writ petition, as cast under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution Constitution of India, is appealable under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 2006.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has made a request to allow the petitioner to withdraw the instant petition, with liberty to approach the authorities concerned, for the relief, as sought in the instant writ petition.

sentences.text: The prayer made by the learned counsel for the petitioner is not opposed by the learned State counsel.
Consequently, the instant writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn, withdrawn, with the aforesaid liberty.

4. In case, the petitioner files an appeal before the authority concerned, within a period of one month, from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order/judgment, along with an application for condonation of 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2025:PHHC:012720 CWP-16167 delay, the authorities concerned shall consider the application of the petitioner sympathetically, specifically, in view of the fact that the petitioner has earlier opted to file a wrong motion before this Court.
(KULDEEP TIWARI) JUDGE January 28,, 2025 Manpreet Whether speaking/reasoned : Yes/No
